description: Complex layered PDF with multiple overlapping vector and scanned elements

source.generation_method: Generated via tests/fixtures/hybrid/hybrid-010-generator.py using raw PDF construction: full-page scanned document (1-bit grayscale image XObject) with multiple overlapping vector layers including headers, footers, sidebar columns, annotations, and vector shapes (rectangles, lines) at different positions

hybrid_behavior.vector_regions: Multiple distinct vector layers: header section (top ~10%), footer section (bottom ~10%), sidebar column (left ~25%), main column (right ~60%), annotation box (bottom right corner), vector shapes (horizontal dividers, vertical separator line, rectangular border)
hybrid_behavior.scanned_regions: Full-page scanned document background (1-bit grayscale image XObject with horizontal text line pattern)
hybrid_behavior.overlap_description: Multiple overlapping vector layers at different page positions, creating distributed hybrid cells throughout the page with diverse patterns (headers, footers, columns, annotations, shapes)

grid_cell_coverage.hybrid_cell_locations: Most grid cells contain both scanned background and some vector layer (header cells: rows 0-1; footer cells: row 7; sidebar cells: rows 2-6, cols 0-1; main column cells: rows 2-6, cols 2-7; annotation cells: row 5-6, cols 6-7; shape cells: dividers at rows 1 and 7)

classification_challenges: Multiple non-contiguous vector regions require comprehensive cell-level scanning
Complex layering with headers, footers, columns, and annotations tests merge rule comprehensiveness
Vector shapes (lines, rectangles) add geometric hybrid content beyond text
High hybrid cell percentage (87.5%) tests upper-bound classification behavior
Tests classification accuracy on documents with layered layout complexity similar to real-world forms/letters
test_focus: Complex multi-region hybrid cell detection across entire page
Merge rule accuracy with multiple non-overlapping vector regions
Geometric shape handling in hybrid context (lines, rectangles)
Classification confidence on high-percentage hybrid pages
Extraction quality with diverse vector layer types (text, shapes, layout elements)
notes: Synthetic fixture designed to test complex multi-layered hybrid content. This fixture represents a realistic document with multiple structural elements (headers, footers, columns, annotations, shapes) creating hybrid cells across most of the page. With 87.5% hybrid cells, it tests the upper bound of hybrid detection and validates that the classifier correctly handles complex real-world layouts where vector elements serve both content and structural purposes (dividers, borders, layout guides).
